races.title: Dudley Peverill Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: SERAPHIC is now going the right way for his current yard and remains well treated on his form in France, so he's fancied to complete the hat-trick. Mariole is entitled to come on for his recent comeback run at Worcester and is second choice. SERAPHIC (IRE) MARIOLE (FR) MISTER DES PLACES (FR)
races.bettingForecast: Seraphic (13/8), Mariole (7/2), Mister Des Places (4/1), Henrysbrotherjack (5/1), Douglas Dc (6/1)

races.title: FCN Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: LARGY FORCE was thriving over fences when last seen and, back over hurdles after a breathing operation, looks worth siding with under favourable conditions. Stablemate Kefir d’Oudairies is the main threat if belatedly building on last season’s Market Rasen second, while Dylans Moon is also dangerous if reproducing his debut form. LARGY FORCE (IRE) KEFIR D'OUDAIRIES (FR) DYLANS MOON
races.bettingForecast: Largy Force (13/8), Dylans Moon (3/1), Arcturus Flame (7/2), Kefir D'oudairies (4/1), Orchard County (20/1)

races.title: Arnold Thomson Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: A trappy contest in which ADONEDEAL is chanced on chase debut. Having looked promising over hurdles before his form tailed off last season, this winning pointer should take to fences and may be the type to catch first time up. Fresh Perspective is feared most if his jumping holds up, while Crystal Days and Soldier’s Leap are also respected in a race where cases can be made for all 4 runners. ADONEDEAL (IRE) FRESH PERSPECTIVE CRYSTAL DAYS
races.bettingForecast: Crystal Days (10/11), Fresh Perspective (7/2), Soldier's Leap (4/1), Adonedeal (6/1)

races.title: Newton LDP Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: BROADWAY HONEY has proved a revelation since tackling the larger obstacles and this looks an excellent opportunity for Nigel & Willy Twiston-Davies' mare to extend her winning sequence to 4. Ignore The Door promises to be suited by a return to this longer trip so he can edge out Yes Day for the forecast spot. BROADWAY HONEY (IRE) IGNORE THE DOOR (IRE) YES DAY (IRE)
races.bettingForecast: Broadway Honey (5/6), Ignore The Door (3/1), Yes Day (4/1), Jupiter Des Bordes (10/1)

races.title: BNG Made Easy With Reverte Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: Cases can be made for a few of these, but the vote goes to PADDY DE POLE , who notched his fifth success over hurdles at Sedgefield a couple of months ago and Paul Nicholls' 8-y-o returns only 2 lb higher. He can enhance his fine record under Freddie Keighley at the expense of Jackstell , whose yard couldn't be in much better form. Oakley looks best of the rest. PADDY DE POLE (IRE) JACKSTELL (FR) OAKLEY (GER)
races.bettingForecast: Paddy De Pole (2/1), Jackstell (3/1), Oakley (7/2), Secret Trix (6/1), I'm A Starman (8/1), Jaytee (14/1)

races.title: Pegasus Handicap Chase
races.verdict: TROPICAL TALENT hasn't won for ages but recent performances in this sphere suggest that could be about to change. Sporting first-time blinkers, he gets the vote over Alba Crus , who was in the process of running well on his chasing debut back in the spring and returns having had a breathing operation. Top-weight Mary rounds off the shortlist. TROPICAL TALENT ALBA CRUS (IRE) MARY (IRE)
races.bettingForecast: Mary (13/8), Alba Crus (5/2), Tropical Talent (4/1), Midnight View (8/1), River Don (10/1), Boom Boom (16/1)

races.title: Farol Fillies' 'Junior' NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict: KATIES TURN hails from a stable with a good bumper record and is selected to make a winning start. Sunshine Sheila is partnered by a good-value claimer and is also respected on her debut, while Nervousdisposition 's pedigree suggests that an emphasis on speed will suit her better than most. KATIES TURN SUNSHINE SHEILA (FR) NERVOUSDISPOSITION
races.bettingForecast: Katies Turn (6/5), Sunshine Sheila (2/1), Star Of Joy (8/1), Nervousdisposition (12/1), Poppy's Mist (14/1), Lady Inca (16/1), Maria's Double (20/1)
